title: Cutlery organization: sort the utensils into the drawer
category: C qualified throughput (all items as quickly as possible)
household_need: Clean cutlery from the table has to go back into the drawer, each kind in its own compartment, and the time to do it is limited.
instruction: Spoons, forks and knives are mixed on the table. Put each one into its compartment of the open drawer (each compartment already holds one of its kind). A utensil counts while it lies at rest, released, inside the compartment of its kind and below the tops of its walls: lying across a wall does not count. At the end none may be in a wrong compartment or off the counter, and the three utensils already in the drawer must stay in their compartments. Sort all of them as quickly as possible.
core_interventions: tell spoon, fork and knife apart by their heads
match each kind to its compartment by the utensil already in it
pinch a flat handle off the table, turn it along the compartment, lay it in
share the drawer between the two arms

process.model: six loose utensils (two spoons, two forks, two knives) on the counter; an open three-compartment drawer with one reference utensil per compartment (nine loose utensils until 2026-11-09)

hidden.layout: per seed: which utensil lies in which of six table slots (+-0.6 cm across, +-1 cm along, +-8 deg) and the compartment order (one of six)

nominal.seed_0: compartments spoons / forks / knives from left to right; three utensils left of the drawer, three right

process.cue: the heads of the utensils and the reference utensil in each compartment (agent camera)

timing.event: a utensil counts as sorted while it rests (< 5 cm/s), released, inside the compartment of its kind, below the wall tops
timing.rule: C-class batch task (score_version 2, docs/c-class-timing.md): the six loose utensils are the jobs; t_Q is the first time all six are sorted at once. One run per seed to H = 5 t_o (t_o = 25.56 s, measured on the six-utensil scene: 127.8 s at every difficulty), scored at every tier, T = 4 / 2 / 1 t_o; the difficulty changes nothing in the episode. Ends early 2 s after all six are sorted, or on a stall (from T_medium, no new utensil sorted for max(0.5 t_o, 1.5 T_easy / 6) = 1.0 t_o). Until 2026-11-09: 45 s / time_scale, quota 6 of 9

physical: all six loose utensils sorted at the end
no utensil in a wrong compartment at the end
reference utensils stay in their compartments
completion.temporal: t_Q within the tier budget T = m x t_o (no physical terms)

failures: reference utensil moved out of its compartment
utensil left in a wrong compartment
permitted: laying a utensil either way round
arm_roles: oracle: each arm sorts the utensils on its side of the drawer, nearest first; only one arm is over the drawer at a time

layout.drawer: static, 27.2 x 26.6 cm outside, centre (0.30, -0.10) m; compartments 8 x 25 cm, walls 4.5 cm, floor 8 mm
layout.table: six slots, three per arm, 5.5 cm apart: x 0.015 to 0.125 m (left arm) and 0.475 to 0.585 m (right arm), y -0.01 to 0.01 m (until 2026-11-09 nine: also x -0.04 and 0.64 m and a far slot at (0.04, 0.205) m)
layout.reach: top-down pinches at the counter reach about 0.46 m from each base
